space.name: env_layout_15
space.notes: T-K part 1's basic room, for the tests of context knowledge on kitting (Hadi's design, 3 October 2026), in the IRB (idle robot) and the MPB (working robot): five targets fan out from the kitting table. A square 1000 x 1000; kitting_table_0 at the middle of the north wall (0, 450). Seen from the table's centre (bearing in degrees, x east, y north; distance between centres): shelf_3 (-450, -5) -134.7 deg 640 cm; shelf_1 (-155, -450) -99.8 deg 913 cm; shelf_4 (150, -450) -80.5 deg 912 cm; coffee_machine_0 (475, -275) -56.8 deg 867 cm; shelf_2 (445, 150) -34.0 deg 537 cm. corner_NE (450, 450) is the one landmark, the exit walk's target; no door, no A/C switch (so no ac_activation hypothesis: once no delivery is live, coffee_break is the one live hypothesis, whatever its strength), no obstacles. Not designed to produce a recognizer result. Stated consequences: the fan spans 100.7 deg; neighbouring targets are 19.2 to 34.9 deg apart; the walks from the table are 537 to 913 cm; no walk from the table passes within 60 cm of another object's footprint; the fixed objects' centres are at least 300 cm apart; the coffee machine's neighbours by bearing are shelf_2 (22.8 deg) and shelf_4 (23.8 deg); corner_NE's bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from shelf_2's.

env_objects.notes: The middle of the north wall, against it; the one kitting table, shared.
The south wall, west of centre; -99.8 deg from the table, 913 cm.
The east wall, north of centre; -34.0 deg from the table, 537 cm.
The east wall, south of centre; -56.8 deg from the table, 867 cm, between shelf_2 and shelf_4 by bearing.
The west wall, at mid-height; -134.7 deg from the table, 640 cm.
The south wall, east of centre; -80.5 deg from the table, 912 cm.

Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls. From kitting_table_0 its bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from the nearest target's (shelf_2); (450, -450) would be 6.6 deg from the coffee machine's. From the coffee machine the walk here passes through shelf_2's footprint, from shelf_4 27 cm from it.
